APPENDIX III
REVIEW COMMENTS AND RESPONSES
Agencies which reviewed and commented upon the environmental statement were the Department of Transportation, Department of Interior, Department of State, the Environmental Protection Agency, and the U.S. Atomic Energy Commission.
The reviewers comments were thoughtful and appreciated.

Their major concern, of course, is with the possibility of encountering hydrocarbons upon drilling into the sea bottom sediments beneath the ice shelf. It should be reiterated that this concern was also of prime importance to those planning the project and those responsible for the preparation of the environmental impact statement. The area in which the drilling is to take place has been studied by seismic refraction and although this does not give detailed knowledge of the sea sediment it does not indicate any major structural features indicative of hydrocarbons. As drilling into the sediment proceeds, extreme care will be given to monitoring the sediment core for hydrocarbons. If substantial hydrocarbons are encountered the hole will be plugged and abandoned.
